verdict.rationale: Datadog Monitors (datadog-docs-10) can be configured with rule-based conditions that trigger notifications, and Watchdog (datadog-docs-16) surfaces automated anomaly detection, implying some rule-to-action capability, but the evidence pack has no explicit mention of a workflow-automation engine, webhook/action-trigger configuration, or AI-native automation rules connecting events to arbitrary actions. missing for 10: dedicated Workflow Automation product documentation, explicit event-to-action rule examples, and independent/hands-on confirmation that automated actions actually fire.
